title: Paper ledger must not sell shares it does not hold

hosted_verification.statement: Hosted verification was not run. Per task brief, no VM/SSH access, no workflow dispatches, and no hosted verification are permitted in this task.

ac1_zero_or_negative_sell_rejected.implementation: services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py::PaperExecutionAlgorithm.SubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder checks normalised underlying holding via _taiwan_underlying_holding_quantity(native, exchange); when holding_quantity <= 0 on a sell order, publishes order_rejection with broker_submission_status='sell_without_holdings' and metadata reason='sell_without_holdings', requested_quantity, and holding_quantity, with no broker post, no fill, no cash change, and no position change.

ac2_partial_clamp_to_held_quantity.implementation: services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py::PaperExecutionAlgorithm.SubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder clamps requested sell qty > holding_quantity to holding_quantity before broker submission (and clamps broker fill_qty if larger), sets fill metadata paper_order_partial_clamped=True, requested_quantity, and clamped_quantity, and ends the position at 0.0 (never negative).

ac3_taiwan_symbol_suffix_normalization.implementation: services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py::PaperExecutionAlgorithm._taiwan_underlying_key, _resolve_holding_symbol, and _taiwan_underlying_holding_quantity resolve 2330.TW and 2330.TWSE to one underlying (2330, TSE) through normalize_taiwan_symbol.

ac4_non_taiwan_and_buy_orders_unchanged.implementation: Non-Taiwan paths and buy orders in paper_runtime.py and executor.py remain unchanged; authorized zero-holding Taiwan cash-share SELL test setups in test_performance_telemetry.py and test_paper_runtime.py seed positive holdings via BUY first per [OPERATOR-T1-TEST-SETUP-AUTHORIZED-20261107].

ac5_probes_accept_sell_without_holdings_.implementation: scripts/probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py, services/trade_journey/hosted_lifecycle_probe.py, and services/trade_journey/hosted_lifecycle_stimulus.py accept order_rejection with metadata.reason == 'sell_without_holdings' as a valid terminal outcome while still rejecting other order_rejection reasons.

ac6_projector_terminal_non_fill_no_unrec.implementation: services/trade_journey/lifecycle_noop_order.py::is_sell_without_holdings_rejection and services/trade_journey/lifecycle_projector.py classify order_rejection with reason=sell_without_holdings as a terminal non-fill state (status='failed', is_terminal=True, fill_event_count=0) with order identifiers stripped so JourneyMaterializer never marks it 'unreconciled'.

ac7_evidence_recorded.implementation: docs/deployment/evidence/PAPER-LEDGER-NO-NEGATIVE-SHARES-20261107/evidence.json records exact commands and results and states plainly that hosted verification was not run.
